metadata.source: Mota et al. (2018), Omega 77:32-57, case study; data as published in Tautenhain et al. (2020), Mendeley Data doi 10.17632/f82by28vnm.2, section 3
conflicts_resolved: Production bill of materials: Mota Table 2 (it agrees with Mota Fig. 3); the Tautenhain data Table 15 swaps the columns of gp1alt and gp2.
Operating cost of gp2: 0.324 EUR/unit (Mota Table 4); the Tautenhain data Table 14 gives 0.314.
Minimum order at the Hannover and Leeds suppliers: 1000/1000/200/1000 units (Mota Table 5); the Tautenhain data Table 17 gives 0.
Minimum warehouse stock: 12000 (fp1) and 10000 (fp2) units (Mota Table 9 and the Tautenhain data text); the Tautenhain data Table 18 shows 391.

Remanufacturing climate-change factors: 134 (gr1) and 103 (gr2) kg CO2e/kg (Tautenhain data Table 24), 25% and 20% of gp1 and gp2; Mota's text says 25% and 20% lower. Table 24's values reproduce Mota's own results (Table B.2.1, case A, climate change of fp1 production and remanufacturing).
Construction cost in Verona (F1, W1): none, the facilities already exist (Mota Table 8, note a); the Tautenhain paper's Table 7 gives 595 EUR/m2.
assumptions: Weeks per period: 52 (Mota's periods are years; the 17.33 of the Tautenhain data's section 1 is the generator's period). It sets the labour cost per period and the trucks' driving hours (45 h x 52).
Labour cost (Mota Table 8) in EUR per hour; the table states no unit.
Returns: at least 15% (Mota's RetF) and at most 100% (Mota eq. 9) of the previous year's deliveries, one recovered product per final product returned (Mota's BOM^recov, whose value is not published).
Node flow capacity (Mota eq. 12-13; 7,000,000 in the Tautenhain data's section 1) is not imposed, as in the generated instances.
Fuel price 1.7 EUR/l, maintenance 0.3 EUR/km and the truck investment ceiling of 2,000,000 EUR are the fixed values in the Tautenhain data's section 1 (Mota gives them in supplementary material).
Raw-material acquisition emissions: none (Mota's environmental objective has no supplier term).

Mota's objective is the NPV after a 30% profit tax, with salvage values; this model minimises cost (capital at its rental equivalent over the asset lives of Mota Table 20) plus the carbon tax, and taxes the climate-change category only, with construction emissions amortised over 20 years.
Warehouse transhipment (Mota: allowed) is given arcs for final and recovered products alike.

unit_convention.item_quantity: thousands of units (demand, supplies, capacities, stock); costs, weights and areas per thousand units
